title: What Whisper Interfaces Is
definition: Whisper Interfaces: interfaces for subvocal, silent speech.
description:
Strip Whisper Interfaces to its essence and you get interfaces for subvocal, silent speech. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Software Paradigms: first throat sensors understanding, then interface logistics prototypes, then silent commands operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of interface hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

title: Real Research Today: Whisper Interfaces
definition: Today's documented research behind Whisper Interfaces.
description:
The road to Whisper Interfaces is already being paved. DARPA's AI Forward and CodePro programs explore AI-assisted software engineering. The Lean theorem prover and Coq/Isabelle communities verify real software mathematically.

WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Together these programs form the throat sensors foundation that Whisper Interfaces will build on — the interface logistics results, the silent commands methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as interface logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Whisper Interfaces
definition: Estimates Whisper Interfaces readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Whisper Interfaces components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a interface hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Whisper Interfaces operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Whisper Interfaces installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55953 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where throat sensors monitoring, interface logistics redundancy, or silent commands maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Whisper Interfaces Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Whisper Interfaces: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Whisper Interfaces — interfaces for subvocal, silent speech.

Phase 1 — Prove (throat sensors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (interface logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (silent commands): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (privacy modes): interface hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and professionals-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
